completion_meaning: COMPLETE means that the bounded first_artifact prescribed by FOUNDATIONAL_COVERAGE_MATRIX_V0 exists, is content-pinned, and passes its own verifier. It does not mean that the opportunity's deeper research programme, a weakest-base classification, or Weyl quantum gravity is complete.

entries.title: Weak-base audit of one finite exact BV certificate
entries.first_artifact: Choose one small nilpotency/contraction/cohomology certificate, emit a proof-dependency DAG, and write an independent checker using only finite integer or rational identities.
entries.evidence: The fixed energy-2 integer SDR is checked using finite arithmetic, with a PRA sufficiency upper bound and a retained dependency DAG.
entries.deeper_gate: Prove a weakest base or reversal and extend beyond the one fixed energy block.

entries.title: Choice audit of the explicit energy-mode Krein fundamental symmetry
entries.first_artifact: Separate explicit mode labels, finite truncations, the countable l2 direct sum, density, completion, and Fock second quantization; classify each dependency independently.
entries.evidence: The explicitly enumerated one-particle and Fock carriers are classified layer by layer; ZF suffices without Countable Choice for the displayed construction.
entries.deeper_gate: Classify arbitrary Krein decompositions, Sobolev scales, generator domains, traces, states, and physical probability.

entries.title: Hahn-Banach versus explicit-witness crosswalk
entries.first_artifact: For one no-go or cohomology certificate, show whether the conclusion uses an explicit finite dual witness and therefore avoids an appeal to a general separable separation theorem.
entries.evidence: The same finite SDR certificate retains explicit projection, inclusion, homotopy, and nontriviality witnesses, so its displayed derivation does not invoke general Hahn-Banach separation.
entries.deeper_gate: Repeat the derivation trace for continuum no-go and cohomology arguments; no global separation-avoidance theorem follows.

entries.title: ZF audit of the separable C*-algebra to physical-state chain
entries.first_artifact: Build a five-link table for one separable observable algebra: algebra construction, positive functional existence, GNS, chosen physical state, and local-normality or dynamics.
entries.evidence: The detector algebra, explicit states, GNS, semifinite weight, physical selection, and dynamics are separate links; only the first explicit ZF links are constructed.
entries.deeper_gate: Construct and justify a physical state, local normality, full orbit algebra, and nonlinear dynamics.

entries.title: Fragment the spectral theorem actually used
entries.first_artifact: Classify one spectral claim as finite characteristic-polynomial algebra, bounded continuous functional calculus, compact self-adjoint decomposition, or projection-valued measure construction.
entries.evidence: The cylinder energy and Fock lift use explicit diagonal domains and finite fixed-energy fibres, not an abstract spectral-measure theorem.
entries.deeper_gate: Audit Euclidean spectral measures, determinants, traces, and non-explicit operator families separately.

entries.title: Logical-strength audit of one operational reconstruction
entries.first_artifact: Select one finite-dimensional reconstruction lemma and classify its use of continuity, extrema, compactness, and real-number completeness.
entries.evidence: Hardy's K=N exclusion is split between pointwise continuity and an explicitly modulated path; RCA_0 is only a sufficiency upper bound for the latter representation.
entries.deeper_gate: Audit the full reconstruction and prove any reversal before saying a physical postulate implies a mathematical axiom.

entries.title: Foundational audit of one Green-operator existence step
entries.first_artifact: Audit a completed normally-hyperbolic scalar or finite-rank bundle theorem before touching the open full BV witness; list energy estimate, completion, uniqueness, duality, and support dependencies.
entries.evidence: The certified typed biwave theorem is decomposed into geometry, factor Green existence, Sobolev completion, energy estimates, exact resolvent algebra, Volterra convergence, uniqueness, causal support, and adjoint duality.
entries.deeper_gate: Determine weak/choice strength of the analytic layers and construct the full off-shell BV propagator; the finite checker proves no PDE existence.

entries.title: Finite-field versus finite-mode Weyl comparison
entries.first_artifact: Write a non-equivalence ledger comparing finite mode cutoff, finite field phase space, finite-dimensional Hilbert space, and continuum limit obligations.
entries.evidence: Four typed notions of finiteness and all six pairwise non-equivalences are recorded, together with explicit bridge obligations.
entries.deeper_gate: Supply comparison maps, convergence/error semantics, and dynamics for one proposed bridge.

entries.title: Topos-internal Weyl BV reformulation
entries.first_artifact: Only a glossary and obstruction ledger should be attempted before any formal construction.
entries.evidence: Fifteen translations and a closed 12-node prerequisite DAG identify finite BV algebra as the lowest-risk candidate while keeping all internal continuum and quantum construction flags false.
entries.deeper_gate: Select an ambient topos and internalize the fixed finite BV presentation before attempting continuum, causal, state, or QME layers.

does_not_establish: completion of the broader reverse-foundations research programme
a weakest-base classification for all repository mathematics
a reversal from any physical postulate to a set-existence axiom
a choice-free continuum interacting Weyl theory
a full Lorentzian off-shell BV propagator
next_gate: Use the matrix's deeper_gate fields to choose a second-wave theorem; the best bounded formal continuation is O3 finite BV internalization in a selected topos, while the highest physical leverage lies in classifying one analytic Green layer.
